pin.title: Welcome to the Tech Community!
pin.description: Stay tuned for the latest news, updates, and important information about our server and the tech world.

fields.name: Rules
fields.value:
• Be respectful
• No spam or self-promotion
• Use channels appropriately
• Follow Discord ToS

fields.name: Get Started
fields.value: Introduce yourself in #introductions and check out #resources for useful links.

pin.title: Server Rules
pin.description: Please read and follow these rules to keep our community safe and productive.

fields.name: 1. Respect
fields.value: Treat everyone with respect. No harassment, hate speech, or discrimination.

fields.name: 2. No Spam
fields.value: Avoid spamming messages, links, or advertisements.

fields.name: 3. Stay on Topic
fields.value: Use the appropriate channels for your discussions.

fields.name: 4. No NSFW
fields.value: Keep all content safe for work.

pin.title: Introduce Yourself!
pin.description: Tell us about your background, interests, and what brings you here.

fields.name: Template
fields.value:
• Name/Alias
• Tech Stack
• Experience Level
• What you hope to learn or share
